date.source: The sub-brand's own weekly broadcast script, posted 11 May 1999.

matches.note: The Atomic Punk splashed a fifty-foot concrete wall down onto Ogre for the pin in his own division debut.
Both shapeshifters traded forms throughout; T-4 finished Lucky II by shifting into an alien and spitting acid in his face.
Nitro Glycerine finished the teleporting Cyber Ninja with his own top-rope finisher after a rapid kicking exchange.

Venom poisoned Spawn with a scratch to the back before the bout, then helped beat him down on the floor while the referee's count ran; the bell was rung in Satan's favor. Afterward Satan and Venom fireballed and further tormented Spawn before Scarlet Surfer, Nightman, T-4 and Thor ran in and drove them off; police escorted Satan and Venom's S.O.S. stable from the ring.
